checks.name: Public DNS resolves to the authorized host
Trusted public HTTPS returns the current simulation manifest
Public proxy hides health, metrics and administration
Native systemd gateway and dedicated database are healthy
Game service, health, backup and certificate timers are enabled
Two-match admission is healthy and QA leaves no active matches
Dedicated database role is restricted and environment remains root-only
Every deployed authority file matches the final Linux release manifest
Fresh database dump verifies and restores real records into an isolated database
Trusted certificate has over 30 days remaining and its renewal hook is installed
Gateway and database listen on loopback rather than public ports
Proxy ticket logging is disabled and native resource/disk guards are configured
